applicationCaseBriefs.expectedPerformanceDe: ZeoNa2+Ca²+⇌ZeoCa+2Na+. applicationCaseBriefs.expectedPerformanceEn: ZeoNa2+Ca²+⇌ZeoCa+2Na+. TwoNa+ compensate the same framework charge as oneCa²+;the framework is not chemically destroyed.2g binds at most2mmolCa²+,leaving1mmol and releasing4mmolNa+. Exchange removes hardness ions,not all dissolved ions,and is not acid-base neutralisation. Equilibrium,kinetics,Mg²+ and real capacity limit the model. This performance does not demonstrate microbial degradation.

Ausgangsstoffentfernung kann Zwischenprodukte, Sorption oder Biomasse einschließen. Benötigt werden C-Bilanz, Produkte und aquatische Wirkungen; Stoff und Bedingungen bestimmen den Weg.
applicationCaseBriefs.expectedPerformanceEn: Ester hydrolysis consumes water and cleaves the ester link;C12 alcohol oxidises throughC12 aldehyde toC12 acid without immediate carbon cleavage. After activation,beta-oxidation cycles removeC2 units;an ideal saturatedC12 chain yields six acetyl units after five shortening cycles. This is not itself completeCO2 measurement.80%primary disappearance can include intermediates,sorption/biomass;30%CO2 does not show full mineralisation. Carbon balance,degradates and aquatic effects are needed;pathways depend on substance/conditions.
